name: @citolab/pci-volcano-model
description: a classroom volcano model: mashed potato in a U-tube, an effervescent tablet and a stopper; viscosity and gas decide between a lava flow, a dome and an explosion
contributors: DEPP (Ministère de l'Éducation nationale) / Jean-Philippe Rivière, Wiquid (original Volcanismepci)
